raw_segments.text: Perdita! Sir, my gracious lord, to chide at your extremes it not becomes me. Oh, pardon
that I name them. Your high self, the gracious Marco T. H. Land, you have obscured with a
swain's wearing and me, poor lowly maid most goddess-like pranked up. But that our feasts
in every mess have folly, and the feeders digest it with a custom, I should blush to
see you so adhered. Swoon, I think, to show myself a glass.
